indexes.name: activity_assignments_active_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_assignments_active_idx ON activity.assignments USING btree (organization_id, activity_id, status) WHERE (revoked_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: activity_assignments_org_target_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_assignments_org_target_idx ON activity.assignments USING btree (organization_id, target_type, target_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: assignments_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assignments_pkey ON activity.assignments USING btree (id)

constraints.name: assignments_activity_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (activity_id) REFERENCES activity.items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: assignments_target_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (target_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['group'::character varying, 'person'::character varying, 'student'::character varying, 'lesson'::character varying, 'homework'::character varying, 'room'::character varying, 'organization'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: activity_attempt_events_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_attempt_events_idx ON activity.attempt_events USING btree (attempt_id, created_at)

indexes.name: attempt_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attempt_events_pkey ON activity.attempt_events USING btree (id)

constraints.name: attempt_events_attempt_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id) REFERENCES activity.attempts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: activity_attempts_idempotency_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX activity_attempts_idempotency_idx ON activity.attempts USING btree (organization_id, participant_person_id, activity_id, idempotency_key) WHERE (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: activity_attempts_participant_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_attempts_participant_idx ON activity.attempts USING btree (organization_id, participant_person_id, activity_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: activity_attempts_version_state_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_attempts_version_state_idx ON activity.attempts USING btree (version_id, state, participant_person_id)

indexes.name: attempts_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attempts_pkey ON activity.attempts USING btree (id)

constraints.name: attempts_activity_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (activity_id) REFERENCES activity.items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: attempts_assignment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assignment_id) REFERENCES activity.assignments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: attempts_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = ANY (ARRAY['CREATED'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'SUBMITTED'::character varying, 'PENDING_REVIEW'::character varying, 'EVALUATED'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'EXPIRED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'INVALIDATED'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: activity_items_fts_ru_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_items_fts_ru_idx ON activity.items USING gin (to_tsvector('russian'::regconfig, (((COALESCE(title, ''::character varying))::text || ' '::text) || COALESCE(description, ''::text))))

indexes.name: activity_items_fts_simple_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_items_fts_simple_idx ON activity.items USING gin (to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, (((COALESCE(title, ''::character varying))::text || ' '::text) || COALESCE(description, ''::text))))

indexes.name: activity_items_legacy_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_items_legacy_idx ON activity.items USING btree (organization_id, source_legacy_type, source_legacy_id) WHERE (source_legacy_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: activity_items_org_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_items_org_idx ON activity.items USING btree (organization_id, status, plugin_code, updated_at DESC)

indexes.name: activity_items_search_trgm_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_items_search_trgm_idx ON activity.items USING gin (title gin_trgm_ops, description gin_trgm_ops)

indexes.name: items_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX items_pkey ON activity.items USING btree (id)

constraints.name: activity_items_active_version_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (active_version_id) REFERENCES activity.versions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: items_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'PUBLISHED'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying, 'ARCHIVED'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: items_visibility_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (visibility::text = ANY (ARRAY['private'::character varying, 'organization'::character varying, 'group'::character varying, 'public_catalog'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: module_migrations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX module_migrations_pkey ON activity.module_migrations USING btree (name)

indexes.name: plugins_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX plugins_pkey ON activity.plugins USING btree (code)

indexes.name: activity_question_bank_org_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_question_bank_org_idx ON activity.question_bank USING btree (organization_id, archived_at, category, difficulty)

indexes.name: question_bank_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX question_bank_pkey ON activity.question_bank USING btree (id)

constraints.name: question_bank_question_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (question_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['single_choice'::character varying, 'multi_choice'::character varying, 'true_false'::character varying, 'short_text'::character varying, 'numeric'::character varying, 'matching'::character varying, 'ordering'::character varying, 'long_text'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: activity_versions_item_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_versions_item_idx ON activity.versions USING btree (activity_id, version_number DESC)

indexes.name: activity_versions_reveal_policy_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_versions_reveal_policy_idx ON activity.versions USING btree (reveal_answers_policy, ((config ->> 'revealAnswersPolicy'::text)))

indexes.name: versions_activity_id_version_number_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX versions_activity_id_version_number_key ON activity.versions USING btree (activity_id, version_number)

indexes.name: versions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX versions_pkey ON activity.versions USING btree (id)

constraints.name: activity_versions_reveal_policy_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (reveal_answers_policy::text = ANY (ARRAY['never'::character varying, 'immediate'::character varying, 'after_grading'::character varying, 'deadline'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: versions_activity_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (activity_id) REFERENCES activity.items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: versions_grading_policy_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (grading_policy::text = ANY (ARRAY['highest'::character varying, 'latest'::character varying, 'average'::character varying, 'practice_no_grade'::character varying]::text[]))
